blb.text: King Glarb, haunted by visions of Valley's destruction by Calamity Beasts, hired Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg so he could raise it as Valley's protector.
The theft ordered by Glarb reawakened the Great Maha's anger, and Glarb announced that Calamity Beasts were running through Valley and claimed to have a plan.

When Mabel's party reached Fountainport, he admitted that he had paid Cruelclaw for the egg and revealed his plan to control the Calamity Beast within it, then bound the party and ordered Cruelclaw's Direshades to kill them.
The party broke free and fought Glarb, and when the Storm Hawk dived at him he escaped by portal, leaving Fountainport as Maha arrived and Mabel calmed her by returning the egg.
